dn6:1.2: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Vesāliyaṃ viharati Mahāvane kūṭāgāra- sālāyaṃ.
dn6:1.3: Tena kho pana samayena sambahulā Kosalakā ca brāhmaṇa-dūtā Māgadhakā ca brāhmaṇa-dūtā Vesāliyaṃ paṭivasanti kenacid eva karaṇīyena.
dn6:1.4: Assosuṃ kho te Kosalakā ca brāhmaṇadūtā Māgadhakā ca brāhmaṇa-dūtā:
dn6:1.5: ‘Samaṇo khalu bho Gotamo Sakya-putto Sakya-kulā pabbajito Vesāliyaṃ viharati Mahāvane kūṭāgāra-sālāyaṃ.
dn6:1.6: Taṃ kho pana Bhagavantaṃ Gotamaṃ evaṃ kalyāṇo kittisaddo abbhuggato:
dn6:1.7: "Iti pi so Bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho vijjā-caraṇa- sampanno sugato loka-vidū anuttaro purisadamma-sārathi satthā deva-manussānaṃ buddho bhagavā."
dn6:1.8: So imaṃ lokaṃ sadevakaṃ samārakaṃ sabrahmakaṃ sassamaṇa-brāhmaṇiṃ pajaṃ sadeva-manussaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā pavedeti.
dn6:1.9: So dhammaṃ deseti ādi-kalyāṇaṃ majjhe kalyāṇaṃ pariyosāna-kalyāṇaṃ sātthaṃ savyañjanaṃ, kevala-paripuṇṇaṃ parisuddhaṃ brahma-cariyaṃ pakāseti.
dn6:1.10: Sādhu kho pana tathā-rūpānaṃ arahataṃ dassanaṃ hotīti."' 2.
dn6:2.1: Atha kho te Kosalakā ca brāhmaṇa-dūtā Māgadhakā ca brāhmaṇa-dūtā yena Mahāvanaṃ kūṭāgāra-sālā ten' upasaṃkamiṃsu.
dn6:2.2: Tena kho pana samayena āyasmā Nāgito Bhagavato upaṭṭhāko hoti.
dn6:2.3: Atha kho te Kosalakā ca brāhmaṇa-dūtā Māgadhakā ca brāhmaṇa-dūtā yen' āyasmā Nāgito ten' upasaṃkamiṃsu, upasaṃkamitvā āyasmantaṃ Nāgitaṃ etad avocuṃ:
dn6:2.4: ‘Kahan nu kho bho Nāgita etarahi so bhavaṃ Gotama viharati,
dn6:2.5: dassana-kāmā hi mayaṃ taṃ Gotaman ti?'
dn6:2.6: ‘Akālo kho āvuso Bhagavantaṃ dassanāya, patisallīno Bhagavā ti.'
dn6:2.7: Atha kho te Kosalakā ca brāhmaṇa-dūtā Māgadhakā ca brāhmaṇa-dūtā tatth' eva ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu:
dn6:2.8: ‘Disvā va mayaṃ taṃ Bhagavantaṃ Gotamaṃ gamissāmāti.' 3.
dn6:3.1: Oṭṭhaddho pi Licchavi mahatiyā Licchavi-parisāya saddhiṃ yena Mahāvanaṃ kūṭāgāra-sālā yen' āyasmā Nāgito ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā āyasmantaṃ Nāgitaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhāsi. Ekamantaṃ ṭhito kho Oṭṭhaddho Licchavi āyasmantaṃ Nāgitaṃ etad avoca:
dn6:3.2: ‘Kahan nu kho bhante Nāgita etarahi so Bhagavā viharati arahaṃ sammā-sambuddho,
dn6:3.3: dassana-kāmā hi mayaṃ taṃ Bhagavantam arahantaṃ sammā- sambud- dhanti?'
dn6:3.4: ‘Akālo kho Mahāli Bhagavantaṃ dassanāya, patisallīno Bhagavā' ti.
dn6:3.5: Oṭṭhaddho pi Licchavi tatth' eva ekamantaṃ nisīdi:
dn6:3.6: ‘Disvā v' ahan taṃ Bhagavantaṃ gamissāmi arahantaṃ sammā-sambuddhan ti.' 4.
dn6:4.1: Atha kho Sīho samaṇuddeso yen' āyasmā Nāgito ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā āyasmantaṃ Nāgitaṃ abhi vādetvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhāsi. Ekamantaṃ ṭhito kho Sīho samaṇuddeso āyasmantaṃ Nāgitaṃ etad avoca:
dn6:4.2: ‘Ete bhante Kassapa sambahulā Kosalakā ca brāhmaṇa-dūtā Māgadhakā ca brāhmaṇa-dūtā idh' upasaṃkantā Bhagavantaṃ dassanāya. Oṭṭhaddho pi Licchavi mahatiyā Licchaviparisāya saddhiṃ idh' upasaṃkanto Bhagavantaṃ dassanāya. Sādhu bhante Kassapa labhataṃ esā janatā dassanāyāti.'
dn6:4.3: ‘Tena hi Sīha tvaṃ yeva Bhagavato ārocehīti.'
dn6:4.4: ‘Evaṃ bhante' ti kho Sīho samaṇuddeso āyasmato Nāgitassa paṭissutvā yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhāsi. Ekamantaṃ ṭhito kho Sīho samaṇuddeso Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:
dn6:4.5: ‘Ete bhante sambahulā Kosalakā ca brāhmaṇadūtā Māgadhakā ca brāhmaṇa-dūtā idh' upasaṃkantā Bhagavantaṃ dassanāya. Oṭṭhaddho pi Licchavi mahatiyā Licchavi-parisāya saddhiṃ idh' upasaṃkanto Bhagavantaṃ dassanāya.
dn6:4.6: Sādhu bhante labhataṃ esā janatā Bhagavantaṃ dassanāyāti.'
dn6:4.8: ‘Evam bhante' ti kho Sīho samaṇuddeso Bhagavato paṭissutvā vihāra-pacchāyāya āsanaṃ paññāpesi.
dn6:4.9: Atha kho Bhagavā vihārā nikkhamma vihāra-pacchāyāya paññatte āsane nisīdi. 5.
dn6:5.1: Atha kho te Kosalakā ca brāhmaṇa-dūtā Māgadhakā ca brāhmaṇa-dūtā yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṃkamiṃsu. Upasaṃkamitvā Bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodiṃsu
dn6:5.2: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu.
dn6:5.3: Oṭṭhaddho pi Licchavi mahatiyā Licchavi-parisāya saddhiṃ yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā Bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho Oṭṭhaddho Licchavi Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca: ‘Purimāni bhante divasāni purimatarāni Sunakkhatto Licchavi-putto yenāhaṃ ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā maṃ etad avoca:
dn6:5.4: "Yad agge ahaṃ Mahāli Bhagavantaṃ upanissāya viharissāmi na ciraṃ tīṇi vassāni, dibbāni hi kho rūpāni passāmi piya-rūpāni kāmūpasaṃhitāni rajanīyāni, no ca kho dibbāni saddāni suṇāmi piya-rūpāni kāmūpasaṃhitāni rajanīyānīti."
dn6:5.5: Santān' eva nu kho bhante Sunakkhatto Licchavi-putto dibbāni saddāni nāssosi piya-rūpāni kāmūpasaṃhitāni rajanīyāni, no udāhu asantānīti?'
dn6:5.7: ‘Santān' eva kho Mahālī Sunakkhatto Licchavi-putto dibbāni saddāni nāssosi piya-rūpāni kāmūpasaṃhitāni rajanīyāni no asantānīti.' 6.
dn6:6.1: ‘Ko nu kho bhante hetu, ko paccayo, yena santān' eva Sunakkhatto Licchavi-putto dibbāni saddāni nāssosi piya-rūpāni kāmūpasaṃhitāni rajanīyāni no asantānīti?'
dn6:6.2: ‘Idha Mahāli bhikkhuno puratthimāya disāya ekaṃsabhāvito samādhi hoti dibbānaṃ rūpānaṃ dassanāya piyarūpānaṃ kāmūpasaṃhitānaṃ rajanīyānaṃ, no ca kho dibbānaṃ saddānaṃ savanāya piya-rūpānaṃ kāmūpasaṃhitānaṃ rajanīyānaṃ.
dn6:6.3: So puratthimāya disāya ekaṃsabhāvite samādhimhi dibbānaṃ rūpānaṃ dassanāya piyarūpānaṃ kāmūpasaṃhitānaṃ rajanīyānaṃ, no ca kho dibbānaṃ saddānaṃ savanāya piya-rūpānaṃ kāmūpasaṃhitānaṃ rajanīyānaṃ ,
dn6:6.4: puratthimāya disāya dibbāni rūpāni passati piya-rūpāni kāmūpasaṃhitāni rajanīyāni, no ca kho dibbāni saddāni suṇāti piya-rūpāni kāmūpasaṃhitāni rajanīyāni.
dn6:6.6: Evaṃ h' etaṃ Mahāli hoti bhikkhuno puratthimāya disāya ekaṃsa-bhāvite samādhimhi dibbānaṃ rūpānaṃ dassanāya piya-rūpānaṃ kāmūpasaṃhitānaṃ rajanīyānaṃ, no ca kho dibbānaṃ saddānaṃ savanāya piya-rūpānaṃ kāmūpasaṃhitānaṃ rajanīyānaṃ. 7.
dn6:7.1: ‘Puna ca paraṃ Mahāli bhikkhuno . . . pe . . . dakkhiṇāya disāya . . .
dn6:7.4: uddham adho tiriyaṃ ekaṃsa-bhāvito samādhi hoti dibbānaṃ rūpānaṃ dassanāya piya-rūpānaṃ kāmūpasaṃhitānaṃ rajanīyānaṃ, no ca kho dibbānaṃ saddānaṃ savanāya piya-rūpānaṃ kāmūpasaṃhitānaṃ rajanīyānaṃ.
dn6:7.5: So uddham adho tiriyaṃ ekaṃsa-bhāvite samādhimhi dibbānaṃ rūpānaṃ dassanāya piya-rūpānaṃ kāmūpasaṃhitānaṃ rajanīyānaṃ, no ca kho dibbānaṃ saddānaṃ savanāya piya-rūpānaṃ kāmūpasaṃhitānaṃ rajanīyānaṃ,
dn6:7.6: uddham adho tiriyaṃ dibbāni rūpāni passati piya-rūpāni kāmūpasaṃhitāni rajanīyāni , no ca kho dibbāni saddāni suṇāti piya-rūpāni kāmūpasaṃhitāni rajanīyāni.
dn6:7.8: Evaṃ h' etaṃ Mahāli hoti bhikkhuno uddham adho tiriyaṃ ekaṃsa-bhāvite samādhimhi dibbānaṃ rūpānaṃ dassanāya piya-rūpānaṃ kāmūpasaṃhitānaṃ rajanīyānaṃ, no ca kho dibbānaṃ saddānaṃ savanāya piya-rūpānaṃ kāmūpasaṃhitānaṃ rajanīyānaṃ. 8.
dn6:8.1: ‘Idha Mahāli bhikkhuno puratthimāya disāya ekaṃsabhāvito samādhi hoti dibbānaṃ saddānaṃ savanāya piyarūpānaṃ kāmūpasaṃhitānaṃ rajanīyānaṃ, no ca kho dibbānaṃ rūpānaṃ dassanāya piya-rūpānaṃ kāmūpasaṃhitānaṃ rajanīyānaṃ.
dn6:8.2: So puratthimāya disāya ekaṃsabhāvite samādhimhi dibbānaṃ saddānaṃ savanāya piyarūpānaṃ kāmūpasaṃhitānaṃ rajanīyānaṃ, no ca kho dibbānaṃ rūpānaṃ dassanāya piya-rūpānaṃ kāmūpasaṃhitānaṃ rajanīyānaṃ,
dn6:8.3: puratthimāya disāya dibbāni saddāni suṇāti piya-rūpāni kāmūpasaṃhitāni rajanīyāni, no ca kho dibbāni rūpāni passati piya-rūpāni kāmūpasaṃhitāni rajanīyāni.
dn6:8.5: Evaṃ h' etaṃ Mahāli hoti bhikkhuno puratthimāya disāya ekaṃsa-bhāvite samādhimhi dibbānaṃ saddānaṃ savanāya piya-rūpānaṃ kāmūpasaṃhitānaṃ rajanīyānaṃ, no ca kho dibbānaṃ rūpānaṃ dassanāya piya-rūpānaṃ kāmūpasaṃhitānaṃ rajanīyānaṃ. 9.
dn6:9.1: ‘Puna ca paraṃ Mahāli bhikkhuno dakkhiṇāya disāya . . .
dn6:9.4: uddham adho tiriyaṃ ekaṃsa-bhāvito samādhi hoti dibbānaṃ saddānaṃ savanāya piya-rūpānaṃ kāmūpasaṃhitānaṃ rajanīyānaṃ, no ca kho dibbānaṃ rūpānaṃ dassanāya piyarūpānaṃ kāmūpasaṃhitānaṃ rajanīyānaṃ.
dn6:9.5: So uddham adho tiriyaṃ ekaṃsa-bhāvite samādhimhi dibbānaṃ saddānaṃ savanāya piya-rūpānaṃ kāmūpasaṃhitānaṃ rajanīyānaṃ, no ca kho dibbānaṃ rūpānaṃ dassanāya piya-rūpānaṃ kāmūpasaṃhitānaṃ rajanīyānaṃ,
dn6:9.6: uddhaṃ adho tiriyaṃ dibbāni saddāni suṇāti piya-rūpāni kāmūpasaṃhitāni rajanīyāni, no ca kho dibbāni rūpāni passati piya-rūpāni kāmūpasaṃhitāni rajanīyāni.
dn6:9.8: Evaṃ h' etaṃ Mahāli hoti bhikkhuno uddham adho tiriyaṃ ekaṃsa-bhāvite samādhimhi dibbānaṃ saddānaṃ savanāya piya-rūpānaṃ kāmūpasaṃhitānaṃ rajanīyānaṃ, no ca kho dibbānaṃ rūpānaṃ dassanāya piyarūpānaṃ kāmūpasaṃhitānaṃ rajanīyānaṃ. 10.
dn6:10.1: ‘Idha Mahāli bhikkhuno puratthimāya disāya ubhayaṃsa-bhāvito samādhi hoti dibbānañ ca rūpānaṃ dassanāya piya-rūpānaṃ kāmūpasaṃhitānaṃ rajanīyānaṃ dibbānaṃ saddānaṃ savanāya piya-rūpānaṃ kāmūpasaṃhitānaṃ rajanīyānaṃ.
dn6:10.2: So puratthimāya disāya ubhayaṃsa-bhāvite samādhimhi dibbānaṃ rūpānaṃ dassanāya piyā-rūpānaṃ kāmūpasaṃhitānaṃ rajanīyānam, dibbānañ ca saddānaṃ savanāya piya-rūpānaṃ kāmūpāsamhitāṇaṃ rajanīyānaṃ,
dn6:10.3: puratthimāya disāya dibbāni ca rūpāni passati piya-rūpāni kāmūpasaṃhitāni rajanīyāni, dibbāni saddāni suṇāti piya-rūpāni kāmūpasaṃhitāni rajanīyāni.
dn6:10.5: Evaṃ h' etaṃ Mahāli hoti bhikkhuno puratthimāya disāya ubhayaṃsa-bhāvite samādhimhi dibbānaṃ saddānaṃ dassanāya piya-rūpānaṃ kāmūpasaṃhitānaṃ rajanīyānaṃ, dibbānañ ca saddānaṃ savanāya piya-rūpānaṃ kāmūpasaṃhitānaṃ rajanīyānaṃ. 11.
dn6:11.1: ‘Puna ca paraṃ Mahāli bhikkhuno dakkhiṇāya disāya . . . pe . . .
dn6:11.4: uddham adho tiriyaṃ ubhayaṃsa-bhāvito samādhi hoti dibbānañ ca rūpānaṃ dassanāya piyarūpānaṃ kāmūpasaṃhitānaṃ rajanīyānaṃ, dibbānañ ca saddānaṃ savanāya piya-rūpānaṃ kāmūpasaṃhitānaṃ rajanīyānaṃ.
dn6:11.5: So uddham adho tiriyaṃ ubhayaṃsa-bhāvite samādhimhi dibbānañ ca rūpānaṃ dassanāya piya-rūpānaṃ kāmūpasaṃhitānaṃ rajanīyānaṃ, dibbānañ ca saddānaṃ savanāya piya-rūpānaṃ kāmūpasaṃhitānaṃ rajanīyānaṃ,
dn6:11.6: uddham adho tiriyaṃ dibbāni rūpāni passati piya-rūpāni kāmūpasaṃhitāni rajanīyāni, dibbāni ca saddāni suṇāti piya-rūpāni kāmūpasaṃhitāni rajanīyāni.
dn6:11.8: Evaṃ h' etaṃ Mahāli hoti bhikkhuno uddham adho tiriyaṃ ubhayaṃsa-bhāvite samādhimhi dibbānañ ca rūpānaṃ dassanāya piya-rūpānaṃ kāmūpasaṃhitānaṃ rajanīyānaṃ, dibbānañ ca saddānaṃ savanāya piya-rūpānaṃ kāmūpasaṃhitānaṃ rajanīyānaṃ.
dn6:11.9: ‘Ayaṃ kho Mahāli hetu, ayaṃ paccayo, yena santān' eva Sunakkhatto Licchavi-putto dibbāni saddāni nāssosi piya-rūpāni kāmūpasaṃhitāni rajanīyāni, no asantānīti.' 12.
dn6:12.1: ‘Etāsaṃ nūna bhante samādhi-bhāvanānaṃ sacchikiriyā-hetu bhikkhū Bhagavati brahmacariyaṃ carantīti?'
dn6:12.2: ‘Na kho Mahāli etāsaṃ samādhi-bhāvanānaṃ sacchikiriyā-hetu bhikkhū mayi brahmacariyaṃ caranti.
dn6:12.3: Atthi kho Mahāli aññe ca dhammā uttaritarā ca paṇītatarā ca yesaṃ sacchikiriyā-hetu bhikkhū mayi brahmacariyaṃ carantīti.' 13.
dn6:13.1: ‘Katame pana te bhante dhammā uttaritarā ca paṇītatarā ca yesaṃ sacchikiriyā-hetu bhikkhū Bhagavati brahmacariyaṃ caranti?'
dn6:13.2: ‘Idha Mahāli bhikkhu tiṇṇaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ parikkhayā sotāpanno hoti avinipāta-dhammo niyato sambodhi-parāyano.
dn6:13.3: Ayaṃ pi kho Mahāli dhammo uttaritaro ca paṇītataro ca yassa sacchikiriyā-hetu bhikkhū mayi brahmacariyaṃ caranti.
dn6:13.4: ‘Puna ca paraṃ Mahāli bhikkhu tiṇṇaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ parikkhayā rāga-dosa-mohānaṃ tanuttā sakadāgāmī hoti, sakid eva imaṃ lokaṃ āgantvā dukkhass' antaṃ karoti.
dn6:13.5: Ayaṃ pi kho Mahāli dhammo uttaritaro ca paṇītataro ca yassa sacchikiriyā-hetu bhikkhū mayi brahmacariyaṃ caranti.
dn6:13.6: ‘Puna ca paraṃ Mahāli bhikkhu pañcannaṃ orambhāgiyānaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ parikkhayā opapātiko hoti tatthaparinibbāyi anāvatti-dhammo tasmā lokā.
dn6:13.7: Ayaṃ pi kho Mahāli dhammo uttaritaro ca paṇītataro ca yassa sacchikiriyā-hetu bhikkhū mayi brahmacariyaṃ caranti.
dn6:13.8: ‘Puna ca paraṃ Mahāli bhikkhu āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ ceto -vimuttiṃ paññā-vimuttiṃ diṭṭhe va dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharati.
dn6:13.9: Ayaṃ pi kho Mahāli dhammo uttaritaro ca paṇītataro ca yassa sacchikiriyā-hetu bhikkhū mayi brahmacariyaṃ caranti.
dn6:13.10: ‘Ime kho Mahāli dhammā uttaritarā ca paṇītatarā ca yesaṃ sacchikiriyā-hetu bhikkhū mayi brahmacariyaṃ carantīti.' 14.
dn6:14.1: ‘Atthi pana bhante maggo, atthi paṭipadā etesaṃ dhammānaṃ sacchikiriyāyāti?'
dn6:14.2: ‘Atthi kho Mahāli maggo, atthi paṭipadā etesaṃ dhammānaṃ sacchikiriyāyāti.'
dn6:14.3: ‘Katamo pana bhante maggo, katamo paṭipadā, etesaṃ dhammānaṃ sacchikiriyāyāti?'
dn6:14.5: seyyathīdaṃ sammā-diṭṭhi sammā-saṅkappo sammā-vācā sammā-kammanto sammā-ājīvo sammā-vāyāmo sammā-sati sammā-samādhi.
dn6:14.6: Ayaṃ kho Mahāli maggo, ayaṃ paṭipadā etesaṃ dhammānaṃ sacchikiriyāya. 15.
dn6:15.1: ‘Ekaṃ idāhaṃ Mahāli samayaṃ Kosambiyaṃ viharāmi Ghositārāme.
dn6:15.3: Maṇḍisso ca paribbājako Jāliyo ca dārupattik- antevāsī yenāhaṃ ten' upasaṃkamiṃsu, upasaṃkamitvā mama saddhiṃ sammodiṃsu,
dn6:15.4: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhaṃsu. Ekamantaṃ ṭhitā kho dve pabbajitā maṃ etad avocuṃ:
dn6:15.5: "‘Kin nu kho āvuso bho Gotama taṃ jīvaṃ taṃ sarīram udāhu aññaṃ jīvaṃ aññaṃ sarīran ti?"
dn6:16.1: "‘Tena h' āvuso suṇātha sādhukaṃ manasikarotha bhāsissāmīti."
dn6:16.2: "‘Evaṃ āvuso" ti kho te dve pabbajitā mama paccassosuṃ.
dn6:16.4: ‘Idh' āvuso Tathāgato loke uppajjati arahaṃ sammāsambuddho . . . pe . . . yathā Sāmañña-phale evaṃ vitthāretabbaṃ. . . .
dn6:16.5: Evaṃ kho āvuso bhikkhu sīla-sampanno hoti. . . .
dn6:16.8: Yo nu kho āvuso bhikkhu evaṃ jānāti evaṃ passati, kallan nu kho tass' etaṃ vacanāya
dn6:16.9: "taṃ jīvaṃ taṃ sarīran" ti vā "aññaṃ jīvaṃ aññaṃ sarīran" ti vā ti?'
dn6:16.10: ‘Yo so āvuso bhikkhu evaṃ jānāti evaṃ passati kallaṃ tass' etaṃ vacanāya
dn6:16.11: "taṃ jīvaṃ taṃ sarīran" ti vā "aññaṃ jīvaṃ aññaṃ sarīran" ti vā ti.'
dn6:16.12: ‘Ahaṃ kho pan' etaṃ āvuso evaṃ jānāmi evaṃ passāmi.
dn6:16.14: "taṃ jīvaṃ taṃ sarīran" ti vā "aññaṃ jīvaṃ aññaṃ sarīran" ti vā. 17. ‘Dutiyajjhānaṃ . . . pe . . .
dn6:17.4: Yo nu kho āvuso bhikkhu evaṃ jānāti evaṃ passati, kallan nu kho tass' etaṃ vacanāya
